text.p: Brightpoint Inc and Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said Tuesday they entered into a strategic alliance to develop new customers and markets for Ericsson cellular phones in the United States.

Brightpoint will be Ericsson's exclusive distributor in the United States. In addition, Brightpoint said it will provide inventory management, help develop new points of sale and facilitate Ericsson's aggressive growth plans for 1997 and beyond, the company said.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
The two firms will also link their information systems.
Ericsson is one of the world's leading suppliers of telecommunications products.
Brightpoint distributes wireless communications equipment and related products globally and provides related services.
